Do not infer neurons or edit weights. Return raw JSON only with keys annotations and rules. annotations contains one record for every incorrect response, none for correct responses: {key: string, sample: integer, labels: array, evidence: exact nonempty substring of the response (or <EMPTY_RESPONSE> only for empty text), reason: string}. Allowed labels: constraint_boundary, state_update, algorithm, reasoning_loop, other_unknown. Ground labels in the task specification, actual failed tests and concrete response text. Length alone is not evidence of a reasoning loop. Use other_unknown when no supported diagnosis is possible. rules is an object mapping those five names to explicit diagnostic rules.
